import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int h = scanner.nextInt();
        int n = scanner.nextInt();
        n = n - 1;
        String binaryString = Integer.toBinaryString(n);
        // Pad with leading zeros to length h
        while (binaryString.length() < h) {
            binaryString = "0" + binaryString;
        }

        StringBuilder resultString = new StringBuilder();
        for (int index = 0; index < h; index++) {
            if (index > 0 && binaryString.charAt(index - 1) == '0') {
                resultString.append(binaryString.charAt(index) == '0' ? '1' : '0');
            } else {
                resultString.append(binaryString.charAt(index));
            }
        }

        long totalValue = 0;
        for (int index = 0; index < h; index++) {
            totalValue += 1;
            if (resultString.charAt(index) == '1') {
                totalValue += Math.pow(2, h - index) - 1;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(totalValue);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
